note: Live sign-in evidence (exit gate check 7). Session 1 ran on 2026-10-29 (docs/MANUAL-TESTS.md, the S7.13 session): Sami signed in and the test operator recorded what each screen showed, from his reports and screenshots. Phase A ran version 1 code (54c85bd), Phase B the main line (03e290d). Corrected after the branch review of step 14: a record says passed only where the session notes show exactly the kind the exit gate names. Fields the notes did not record say so. No email, name, account id, login, page name or token is kept. The partial grant and the renewal for Gmail and Calendar ran on 2026-10-29 after the live passes, done by the test operator in the test Google account with Sami's OK; the renewal used the page's new Sign in again.

full-consent.consentPolicy: Google full level: gmail.modify and gmail.settings.basic
full-consent.observed: "Upgrade to full access" ended at Full access with no "Needs more access" row and the upgrade button gone. Google showed no boxes, since the scopes were already granted.
full-consent.alsoSeen: Later the same day the test operator connected Gmail in the live-test folder with Sami's OK: Fabric asked openid, email, gmail.modify and gmail.settings.basic, Google said Fabric (development) already had some access, and the account showed Full access. On the same day, after the access was removed, Google showed both Gmail boxes again at Add account.

partial-grant-add-access.phase: Google sign-in session after the live passes
partial-grant-add-access.actor: The test operator, in the test Google account, with Sami's OK
partial-grant-add-access.setup: Fabric (development)'s access was first removed in the test Google account (Linked apps, Delete all), so Google showed its boxes again.
partial-grant-add-access.observed: Add account with only "See, edit, create or change your email settings and filters" unticked: a new account read "Partial access (1 permission not granted)", one notice named Change mail settings, filters and vacation reply; Delete drafts, labels or filters; Changes that return keys or secrets, and those three rows read "Needs more access" with Add. A cancel at Google changed nothing. Add on the mail settings row: Google asked for that one access only; afterwards Full access, no notice, no "Needs more access" row.
partial-grant-add-access.notices: one not-granted notice, gone after Add

renewal-kept-settings.phase: Google sign-in session after the live passes
renewal-kept-settings.actor: The test operator, in the test Google account, with Sami's OK
renewal-kept-settings.setup: Fabric (development)'s access was first removed in the test Google account (Linked apps, Delete all), so Google showed its boxes again.

here-only-disconnect.observed: The confirm named Google Calendar and offered Cancel, Disconnect here only and Disconnect everywhere; after "Disconnect here only" Gmail read Not connected and Calendar's check still passed. The remote revoke was not exercised live.
